title: Growth Spurts
subtitle: Age-appropriate evidence, prevention, and practical guidance related to growth spurts.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from pediatric endocrinology and nutrition research supports the biological basis and clinical features of growth spurts. Moderate evidence underpins practical guidance related to nutritional needs and symptom management. Emerging evidence addresses variability in growth timing and etiology of growing pains. Safety recommendations align with general pediatric practice guidelines.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
